body:
Corrected only the external archive-preserved refresh helper's baseline inventory parser: `git ls-tree -z` plus NUL splitting now matches `git ls-files -z`. The exact membership assertion and all other preflight guards remain unchanged. V3 and its original failed preflight are preserved.

[Nine external controls](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/8417aaf3a057d855ae5d0b78a587ef1cb57bf28f/reports/step7d_mapping_901_20261103/resumption/post1122-orchestration-readonly-checks-v4.json) cover real Git filenames containing Greek/ß characters and a space/newline, with both quotePath settings; actually missing and added members still fail. The actual protected inventories match exactly at **3,582 paths**. [Independent v4 preflight](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/8417aaf3a057d855ae5d0b78a587ef1cb57bf28f/reports/step7d_mapping_901_20261103/resumption/independent-review/post1122-orchestration-v4-review.json) passes, and the subsequent native refresh completes.

The immutable operator and evidence are archived in [fcf4ba5f](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/commit/fcf4ba5f19ad46126727097b6f5768219fc7832f); this remedy does not change repository tests, workflows, thresholds or owner selection.

PR: [#1128](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/pull/1128), publication head `8417aaf3a057d855ae5d0b78a587ef1cb57bf28f`. [Completed local validation](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/8417aaf3a057d855ae5d0b78a587ef1cb57bf28f/reports/step7d_mapping_901_20261103/resumption/final-local-validation-v1.json) records **5,086 passed, zero failed, one pre-existing skip, 33 warnings**, with `just qc`, unified freshness and unified rejection checks passing. The later 515 changed paths are evidence-only; implementation and scientific inputs retain the tested checkpoint's bytes. **CI completion and final independent review are PENDING in this implementation update.** No merge or issue closure is claimed.
